name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-05-09, at wavelengths from 1.09 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
